description:
Create a Zendesk user, or update the existing user with the same email.

Uses the Zendesk create_or_update endpoint: if a user with the given email
already exists, that user is updated; otherwise a new user is created.
Useful for adding a new customer contact before filing tickets on their
behalf.

Use search_zendesk_users first if you only need to check whether the user exists.

Example:
{
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "organization_id": 500
}

email.description: Email address — the identity key for create-or-update

role.description: User role (Zendesk defaults to end-user when omitted)

subdomain.description: Zendesk subdomain (optional if only one account connected)

name: create_or_update_zendesk_user
